Ce bouton ouvre un fichier du disque pour importer une planche, il ne télécharge rien.

behavioralDecisions.decision: Use stable catalog IDs, canonicalCode and variant. Map Sheet AU58 to AU51 and AU58B to AU58; keep AU56B and AU57B as distinct deep variants. Never resolve AU58 using code alone without source/schema or unambiguous legacy name. Keep sheet positions and source crop keys.

Remove silent final 4950-character truncation and the 420/300/220 field truncations. Preserve 49 complete entries and final sentence. Any actual provider limit belongs to explicit bridge validation; never discard text to satisfy an unverified historical limit.

Transfer structured cue IDs, variant and visible text; do not append a generated FACS paragraph permanently into the editable action. Repeated transfers are idempotent; removing a cue removes its generated instructions. Preserve imported legacy action verbatim and require explicit editing for ambiguous old paragraphs.
Represent inherit-story versus custom explicitly. Migrate nonempty legacy motion selection to custom and empty selection to inherit-story. Custom empty means no cues; do not repopulate it silently.

Keep stable media IDs outside recipe text. Record ordered crop mapping, original sheet and cropVersion. Import from the legacy origin explicitly because IndexedDB on port 3783 is not accessible from port 4326. Do not auto-recrop or relabel the pixels of saved images.

fixtureLimitations: defaultFullBoardPrompt was generated with empty stub fields. It is the fallback case, not initial HTML fields populated from defaultText.
Fixture covers five individual FACS outputs and configured Board examples, not exhaustive input combinations or empty/default Board state. Sol must extend witnesses before porting.
Legacy full-board witnesses intentionally retain truncated text. V6 expectations must explicitly restore the complete template and all cells.

Source inventories are heuristically filtered. Supplemental corpus decisions cover omitted prompt data in inspected ranges; no claim that all unrelated UI/CSS/runtime literals were semantically reviewed.
